limitation: Structural connectivity is not physiological connectivity
consequence: Edge existence and synapse counts do not establish conductance, sign or function

limitation: Transmitter signs are predictions; 55.52% of BANC t5 edges are unsigned
consequence: A structural path may carry no modelled current

limitation: Weights are an arbitrary calibrated transform
consequence: No measurement fixes the scale, exponent or cap
No cell-type-specific physiology, adaptation or bursting

limitation: Inhibition is a hyperpolarising current, not a conductance
consequence: No shunting inhibition or reversal potential
Conduction distance and dendritic filtering are absent
232 neurons for 7 features; no receptive-field map

limitation: The game is not Subway Surfers
consequence: endless-surfer is a separate controlled implementation
LEFT/RIGHT/JUMP are not identified motor commands; ROLL/DUCK unsupported

limitation: Motor silence blocks the experimental chain
consequence: No motor spikes means no action, no reward channel, no behavioural contrast

limitation: Pilot evidence is not campaign evidence
consequence: 3 seeds x 3 episodes; no C1-C4 estimate; N not selected

limitation: Synthetic calibration and decoder tests are not biological evidence
MI is descriptive and does not establish causation
consequence: Circular decoder estimate; small replicate counts; bias floor
Zero motor spikes, zero weight change, identical F/F-beta outcomes

limitation: FAFB is brain-only; the VNC comes from a different dataset
consequence: No limb motor neurons in FAFB; BANC is not merged with FAFB
